The backends of `+ciphers::gcm, aes128_gcm, aes256_gcm+`, from the test programs that run it:

|Backend |Jamfile |Header |Targets

|BearSSL
|`+/third_party//bearssl+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/bearssl.hpp>+`
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten (tested by `+gcm_bearssl+`, `+gcm_wycheproof_bearssl+`, `+agreement_gcm+`, `+agreement_gcm_portable+`)

|OpenSSL
|`+/webcpp/crypto//openssl+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/openssl.hpp>+`
|native, wasip2, wasip3 (tested by `+gcm_openssl+`, `+gcm_wycheproof_openssl+`, `+agreement_gcm+`, `+agreement_gcm_portable+`); not on emscripten: /webcpp/crypto//openssl stops the build there

|ctaes
|`+/third_party//ctaes+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/ctaes.hpp>+`
|refused at compile time (`+gcm_on_ctaes+`)
